violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Medication (26 TAC §744.501(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have in their operational policies a statement on how they will not  give medication to children.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have in their operational policies a statement on how they will not  give medication to children.
The operational policies state that staff do not administer medication. However, inspector observed medication at the operation.

The operation failed to submit an updated copy of the operational policies for medication. This is a re-cite.     The operational policies state that staff do not administer medication. However, inspector observed medication at the operation.
